newsitem.title: USA: U.S. EPA says will rule on Ariz. RFG after May 15.
newsitem.headline: U.S. EPA says will rule on Ariz. RFG after May 15.

text.p: Federal regulators next month expect to set a deadline for the implementation of new cleaner burning gasoline in Phoenix.

The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) plans to announce the deadline between May 15 and June 1, and will not require refiners to supply Phoenix storage terminals before June 15, an EPA spokeswoman confirmed on Monday.
"It will not be earlier than June 15," the spokeswoman said.
Last January, Arizona's governor requested the EPA mandate federal reformulated gasoline (RFG) from June 1.
But several players in the petroleum industry asked for more information in order to product the new gasoline and the agency decided to push back the proposed deadline to accomodate public hearings.
Retail service stations will carry Arizona RFG 30 days after it reaches storage terminals, the EPA said.
